title: News
summary: Announcements from managers: reading, confirming you've read one, and posting (admins).

blocks.text: Team › News shows what managers posted to your teams, pinned ones first.

items: When a post asks you to confirm, tap **I've read this**. Until you do, Home shows a reminder.
Admins post with **Announce**, choose the teams, and can pin a post or ask everyone to confirm.
Admins see "7 of 9 acknowledged" with who is still waiting, and can send them a reminder.

blocks.text: News is for everyone the post is sent to; no page access is needed.
